name: GTFOBins · go (file-write)
command:
echo -e 'package main
import "os"
func main(){
	f, _ := os.OpenFile("/path/to/output-file", os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREATE, 0644)
	f.Write([]byte("DATA\n"))
	f.Close()
}' >/path/to/temp-file.go
go run /path/to/temp-file.go
description: Use go to file write via GTFOBins.
